posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
I believe loops are always slower than block iterators, because of the constant "if index >= max, end; else, loop"
see if you can process everything by whole blocks.
you mention cards.
is there any image loading? loading whole images in memory always takes time.

posts.author: KrillDes
posts.body:
In fact, the interpreter will work equally well with both whole blocks and loops. The interpreter used reads the file as a whole, caching, and then executes the code line by line as specified by the logic (constructors, calls, etc.). There is an interpreter that reads the code line by line, but this is not our case.
Anyway, I do use images, but they are loaded only when the plugin is running. We are talking about configuring the configuration by rpgmz itself. In my case, the editor does not work well with opening the configuration and working with it

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
The problem is you can't fix the editor itself. I don't know how it reads the plugin but clearly it doesn't use JavaScript. Maybe Qt? But the point is you can't change that. There are lots of possibilities, I can only guess. Maybe it reads the file every time when a parameter is a struct. But who knows.
If it can't be fixed maybe you need to consider simplifying it.
Or use external database instead of plugin settings.

I helped another person troubleshoot something like this, and it was a bug in the latest version of MZ, 1.8.1.
